input.rationale: Article VIX is a pure warranty disclaimer: the Licensed Technology is supplied "AS IS" with all warranties, express or implied, disclaimed, and Licensor expressly does not warrant that errors or nonconformity to the Documentation can or will be corrected. There is no affirmative performance or conformance warranty anywhere in the Agreement and no warranty remedy; the only substitute is the Technical Support obligation to "use commercially reasonable efforts to provide Error Corrections" (p0093), which is an efforts-based support covenant, not a warranty with a repair/replace/refund remedy. That is the walk-away position, so we redline to the fallback: 90-day Software conformance to Documentation, 30-day services warranty, with repair or replacement or refund, plus the minimum carve-outs so the disclaimer does not swallow the new express warranties.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.

proposal.summary: Add a 90-day software / 30-day services warranty with repair, replacement or refund, and carve it out of the "AS IS" disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently supplied "AS IS" with all express and implied warranties disclaimed, which is walk-away territory for us, so we have added our fallback warranty (90 days software conformance to Documentation, 30 days support services) with repair, replacement or refund, and carved those express warranties out of the disclaimer so it does not swallow them.
